how: Non-streaming POST to api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions from the running app tab, with the app's own system prompt (imported live from /src/features/llm/ir/ir-prompt.ts via the Vite dev server) and the verbatim Case A / Case B prompts from docs/baseline-geracao.md §1.1. max_tokens: 16000. usage.completion_tokens read straight off the response.

charsPerToken.note: Dense IR JSON runs near 3 chars/token, not the 4 a prose estimate assumes. An earlier version of the ceiling test used 4 and therefore did NOT fail when the ceiling was mutated back to 3000 — the estimate said a 40-node diagram needed 2250 tokens when it actually needs 3610.

conclusion: A complete ~40-node diagram costs 3235-3610 completion tokens. The old ceiling of 3000 could not fit either case, which is why all six Phase 0 runs came back cut mid-string. finish_reason is 'stop' at 16000, so the raised ceiling is not merely larger, it is sufficient for this size.
